title: Network Equipment and Server & Storage Build Orders: Signed Cancellation After the Purchase Order
content:
This Hardware Procurement rule settles the fee charged when the authorized contact's e-signed cancellation of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order takes effect after the order's purchase order was placed and before it shipped; the signature records the cancellation and its fee together.

**Scope.** For a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, and only for such an order, the infrastructure cancellation fee is figured under this infrastructure cancellation schedule, and its paid deposit is returned under the infrastructure deposit-credit schedule. A Standard Endpoint Order is settled under the endpoint cancellation schedule, and every other order type's cancellation after its purchase order stays charged its after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage of the quote total, rounded half up to the cent, with any deposit paid applied against that fee by an order credit and the excess refunded by the accounting team.

| After the signature | |
|---|---|
| Order | cancelled, recorded as cancelled after its purchase order, cancelled and closed on the signing day |
| Request | a signed cancellation request on the order |
| Billing ledger | a cancellation fee invoice for the amount signed, added to what the client owes on the order |

## Invocation: `sign_infrastructure_cancellation_1779b7d3`

**Capability.** The authorized contact e-signs the cancellation of the client's own network or server hardware order whose distributor purchase order has already been placed and which has not shipped. One call records the signed cancellation request, moves the order to cancelled (cancelled after its purchase order, cancelled and closed today) and books the cancellation fee on the order's billing ledger as a new invoice, adding it to the amount the client owes on the order. The client sees the order shown as cancelled and a cancellation fee invoice for the amount signed.

**How it is invoked.** `sign_infrastructure_cancellation_1779b7d3` belongs to the client: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign.

**Parameters.**
- `customer_id`: client reference number of the verified client signing, as returned by the client profile lookup (identifier).
- `hardware_order_id`: reference number of the client's hardware order being cancelled, as returned by the hardware order lookup for this client (identifier).
- `fee_usd`: the cancellation fee the client signs for, in USD, a positive amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the signed request reference, the order reference, the order's new status cancelled, the cancellation fee invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits) and the fee booked in USD with 2 decimal places; receiving it means the cancellation and its fee are on record.
